minutes.headline: Committee agreed to take over track and turf field care from Parks, and heard a 5.5% recommended budget.
minutes.summary: The School Committee approved a line transfer, agreed to join the Turkey Hill building condition study, and accepted the Parks Commission's proposal to hand the track and field to the schools, subject to legal review. It voted on a three-year early literacy agreement and heard the superintendent's recommended budget and draft 2018-19 calendar. It then moved toward executive session.

what_happened.line: The School Committee accepted the Parks Commission motion to transfer care of the track and field to the schools; the vote tally was not audible.
The Parks Commission is to proceed with town counsel review of the track and field transfer before it is finalized.
The Committee voted to enter a three-year early literacy agreement, with the school share financed over three years; the vote tally was not audible.
The Committee voted to join the Turkey Hill Elementary building condition study; the vote tally was not audible.
The superintendent presented a recommended budget showing an overall increase, with health insurance budgeted pending renewal.

why_it_matters: Taking on the track and field moves its upkeep to the school budget, so the cost and the legal terms matter to anyone who pays school or town taxes.
The recommended budget is the starting point for the school appropriation that residents will be asked to vote on at Town Meeting, and health insurance is still an open figure.
